description: TODO: one line telling the user what to enter. Fields under 'Monitoring' make scheduled runs return only new or changed records.

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Listing or search URLs to start from. BUILDER: replace with the source's real entry points, or delete if the Actor is ID-driven only.

ids.title: Item IDs
ids.description: Fetch these item IDs directly, skipping the listing pages. BUILDER: rename to the source's ID concept (SKU, username, ASIN...).

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: Stop after this many items are saved. 0 means no limit. You are charged per saved item, so this also caps cost.

monitoringMode.sectionDescription: Use with a Schedule to get only what changed since the previous run with the same monitoring key.
monitoringMode.title: Monitoring mode
monitoringMode.description: 'all' saves every item. 'new' saves only items never seen in earlier runs. 'newOrChanged' also saves items whose content changed. Unchanged items are skipped and not charged.

monitoringKey.title: Monitoring key
monitoringKey.description: Name for the memory of seen items. Runs with the same key share it. Leave empty to derive it from the input. Letters, digits and ! - _ . ' ( ) only.

since.title: Only items updated since
since.description: Skip items older than this date (YYYY-MM-DD) or relative period (e.g. '7 days'). Requires the source to expose an update date.

proxyProvider.title: Proxy provider
proxyProvider.description: 'auto' uses Decodo when its credentials are set (environment or fields below), otherwise the proxy configuration field. 'decodo' requires Decodo credentials. 'apify' and 'custom' use the proxy configuration field. 'none' disables proxies.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Used when the provider is 'apify' or 'custom', or as the fallback in 'auto'.

decodoUsername.title: Decodo username
decodoUsername.description: Optional. Overrides the DECODO_USER environment variable. Stored encrypted.

decodoPassword.title: Decodo password
decodoPassword.description: Optional. Overrides the DECODO_PASS environment variable. Stored encrypted.

decodoHost.title: Decodo gateway host:port
decodoHost.description: Optional. Overrides the DECODO_HOST environment variable, e.g. gate.example:7000.

skipProxyHealthCheck.title: Skip proxy health check
skipProxyHealthCheck.description: By default the run first requests an IP-echo URL through the proxy and fails fast if the proxy is down.

proxyHealthCheckUrl.title: Proxy health check URL
proxyHealthCheckUrl.description: IP-echo URL requested through the proxy at startup. Must return the caller IP as JSON (ip/origin/query field) or plain text.

maxRequestRetries.title: Max request retries
maxRequestRetries.description: Retries per request on errors, 403/429 responses and challenge pages. Each retry uses a fresh proxy session.

backoffBaseMillis.title: Retry backoff base
backoffBaseMillis.description: First retry waits about this long; each further retry doubles it (with jitter), capped at 30 seconds.

requestTimeoutSecs.title: Request timeout
requestTimeoutSecs.description: Timeout for a single HTTP request.

pushBatchSize.title: Save batch size
pushBatchSize.description: Items are saved (and charged) in batches of this size. Smaller batches lose less work on a hard abort.
